passages.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
passages.sermon: This psalm is for the choirmaster.\r\nThe sons of Korah wrote this psalm.

passages.text: Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
The sons of Korah wrote this psalm.
The psalm is for the choirmaster.
All people, clap your hands.
Shout to God with a voice of joy.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀ לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃ כָּֽל־ הָ֭עַמִּים תִּקְעוּ־ כָ֑ף הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִ֗ים בְּק֣וֹל רִנָּֽה׃

passages.text: How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the Most High.
The LORD is awesome.
The LORD is the great King.
The LORD rules over all the earth.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֣ה עֶלְי֣וֹן נוֹרָ֑א מֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝דוֹל עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.
passages.sermon:
The LORD Most High is awesome.
He is the great King over all the earth.
He subdues nations beneath us.
He places peoples under our feet.
passages.original: יַדְבֵּ֣ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתֵּ֑ינוּ וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים תַּ֣חַת רַגְלֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD with the sound of the horn.
passages.sermon:
God is the Most High.
God is the great King over all the earth.
God chooses our inheritance for us.
God gives us what we will receive.
God chooses the pride of Jacob.
God loves Jacob.
God ascends with a shout of joy.
The LORD rises with the sound of the horn.
passages.original: יִבְחַר־ לָ֥נוּ אֶת־ נַחֲלָתֵ֑נוּ אֶ֥ת גְּא֨וֹן יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲשֶׁר־ אָהֵ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃ עָלָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה בְּק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃

passages.text: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!
passages.sermon:
God is our King.
God deserves praise.
Sing praises to God.
Sing praises to our King.
Give honor to God with your songs.
Give honor to our King with your songs.
passages.original: זַמְּר֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים זַמֵּ֑רוּ זַמְּר֖וּ לְמַלְכֵּ֣נוּ זַמֵּֽרוּ׃

passages.text: For God is King of all the earth; sing profound praises to Him.
passages.sermon:
God is King over all the earth.
He rules everywhere.
Sing praises to God.
Sing with understanding.
Give Him thoughtful praise.
passages.original: כִּ֤י מֶ֖לֶךְ כָּל־ הָאָ֥רֶץ אֱלֹהִ֗ים זַמְּר֥וּ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃

passages.text: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.
passages.sermon:
God rules over all nations.
God sits on His holy throne.
God is King over every people.
God’s throne is holy.
God’s authority covers the whole earth.
passages.original: מָלַ֣ךְ אֱ֭לֹהִים עַל־ גּוֹיִ֑ם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יָשַׁ֤ב׀ עַל־ כִּסֵּ֬א קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.
passages.sermon:
God is the God of Abraham.
God is highly exalted.
The nobles from many nations have gathered together.
They gather as the people of the God of Abraham.
All the shields of the earth belong to God.
God owns all protection and power on earth.
passages.original: נְדִ֘יבֵ֤י עַמִּ֨ים׀ נֶאֱסָ֗פוּ עַם֮ אֱלֹהֵ֪י אַבְרָ֫הָ֥ם כִּ֣י לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים מָֽגִנֵּי־ אֶ֗רֶץ מְאֹ֣ד נַעֲלָֽה׃
